rules.title: Before you start
rules.subtitle: How the app uses your information. Please read the five points below.
rules.timeinText: When you time in, the app checks your location against the job site. If you're outside it, you take a selfie so HR can check.
rules.locationTitle: Your location, only while timed in
rules.locationText: While you're timed in, the app sends your location to the office every minute. It stops when you time out.
rules.whoText: Only Technocycle's office: HR, the Service Department and the CEO.
rules.phoneText: You use the app on one phone, so nobody can time in for you. The app keeps a scrambled code of this phone, not your number, photos or files. Only HR and the CEO see which phone is yours. Clearing the app's data doesn't change it; a new phone needs HR's OK.
rules.aiTitle: The Support assistant is an AI
rules.aiText: Your questions to it are answered by Google's Gemini AI using our company rules. Never type your PIN or passwords there.
rules.readTerms: Read the full Terms of use
rules.agree: I have read this and I agree
rules.saveFailed: Couldn't save your answer. Check your signal and try again.
rules.loadFailed: Couldn't load the app rules. Check your signal and try again.

permissions.title: Allow access
permissions.subtitle: The app needs these from your phone. Android will ask you one by one.
permissions.locationText: To check you're at the work site when you time in. Choose "While using the app".
permissions.cameraText: For the selfie when you time in outside the site, and photos for HR.
permissions.notificationsText: So you know right away about new jobs and HR replies.
permissions.locationNeeded: Time-in needs your location. Turn it on in your phone settings: Permissions → Location → While using the app.
permissions.notificationsLater: Notifications work in the installed app, not in Expo Go.
